title: Testing Tail-Index Homogeneity via Exceedance-Covariate Independence
abstract: arXiv:2610.21019v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a test of whether the tail index of a heavy-tailed outcome is homogeneous across observed covariates. The key observation is that, under tail-index homogeneity, normalized log exceedances are asymptotically independent of the covariates even when tail frequencies vary with them. This leads to a simple-to-implement permutation test based on distance covariance, without estimating conditional tail indices or specifying the form of tail-index heterogeneity. For the global and locally balanced versions, we establish validity for order-statistic thresholds and give conditions for consistency and local power. Local balancing selects extremes within two covariate groups and can improve power when tail selection concentrates the covariates. Simulations illustrate these gains. In French motor insurance data, upper conditional quantiles vary with risk characteristics, but the tail-index tests do not reject a common tail index.

translated_title: 基于超出量-协变量独立性的尾指数同质性检验
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种检验重尾结果变量的尾指数在观测协变量之间是否同质的方法。关键观察是：在尾指数同质性的条件下，归一化的对数超出量与协变量渐近独立，即使尾部频率随协变量变化也是如此。由此产生了一种基于距离协方差的、易于实施的置换检验，无需估计条件尾指数或指定尾指数异质性的具体形式。对于全局版本和局部平衡版本，我们建立了基于次序统计量阈值的有效性，并给出了一致性和局部功效的条件。局部平衡在两个协变量组内选择极端值，当尾部选择使协变量集中时可以提高检验功效。模拟实验展示了这些增益。在法国汽车保险数据中，上条件分位数随风险特征而变化，但尾指数检验并未拒绝共同尾指数的假设。
tldr: 本文提出基于归一化对数超出量与协变量渐近独立性的距离协方差置换检验，可在不估计条件尾指数或指定异质性形式的前提下，检验重尾数据的尾指数在协变量间是否同质。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a distance-covariance-based permutation test that exploits the asymptotic independence between normalized log exceedances and covariates under tail-index homogeneity, enabling testing of tail-index homogeneity without estimating conditional tail indices or specifying the form of heterogeneity.
